content: शमः [शम्-घञ्] .²1 Quiet, tranquillity, calmness; धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो <ls>Bg. 11. 24</ls>. .²2 Rest, calm, repose, cessation. .²3 Absence or restraint of passions, mental quietness, quietism; शमरतेऽमरतेजसि पाथिंवे <ls>R. 9. 4</ls>; <ls>Ki. 10. 10</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">16. 48</ls>; <ls>Śi. 2. 94</ls>; <ls>Bg. 10. 4</ls>. .²4 Allayment, mitigation, alleviation, satisfaction, pacification (of grief, thirst, hunger <ab>&c.</ab>); शममुपयातु ममापि चित्तदाहः <ls>U. 6. 8</ls>; शममेष्यति मम शोकः कथं नु वत्से <ls>Ś. 4. 21</ls>. .²5 Peace; as in अस्माकं शमकामा वै त्वं च पुत्रो ममेत्यथ <ls>Mb. 12. 1. 27</ls>; शमोपन्यास <ls>Ve. 5</ls>. .²6 Final emancipation (from all worldly illusions and attachments). .²7 The hand. .²8 Cure of disease, convalescence. .²9 Indifference, apathy.
